originShared.text: TDLR's ACR002 application states Texas "currently reciprocates with Georgia and South Carolina only".
File ACR002 with the $115 non-refundable application fee.

Experience-only applicants attach Experience Verification Forms showing at least 48 months (4 years) of practical experience in the preceding 72 months (6 years); ACR002 also lets you substitute qualifying education for part of the experience.
Once the application is approved, TDLR notifies the exam provider (PSI); the exam fee is paid directly to PSI.
Submit a Certificate of Insurance after you pass the examination.
